ideas.title: Overdue invoice chasing service (east)
ideas.one_liner: Small trading firms pay a monthly retainer to have overdue invoices chased politely until paid.
steps: Ask one local firm about late payers
Write a 3-step polite chasing sequence
Pitch $180/month per firm at the chamber
Take over the invoice list in a sheet
Send reminders on day 7, 14, 30
Escalate to phone calls after day 30
Report recovery totals every Friday
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Stay polite — you use their name
Never threaten legal action yourself
Confirm who may approve payment plans
